rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

ONE original square 1024x1024 premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Uranus, Pergamon combat iconography.
ANATOMY: bearded male sky god, one head two arms two legs and two feather wings, fully opaque aged-bronze robe and cuirass, plain sword [uranus-c46]
MOMENT: Dive wing-first into a sword strike at a giant silhouette cropped at frame edge; Uranus dominates fully and action occurs under the starry sky.
POWER: Physical sword combat against Giants, no invented cosmic beams; night sky reflects his sky identity [uranus-c01, uranus-c46]

LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant natural storm opening or fire/moon light source in deep walnut and antique-gold palette; strong rim light, deep shadow, physically grounded dust or spray.
SURFACE: tactile weathered cloth, aged metal, living skin, feathers or scales as applicable.
SETTING: dark sky above a rocky combat ledge, editorial staging of documented Gigantomachy [uranus-c01, uranus-c46]
MOOD: overwhelming, imposing, active, dignified where divine; never cute, placid or decorative. Original mythology art, no borrowed modern character designs.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: NO text, letters, pseudo-writing, glyphs, runes, logos, signatures or decorative script anywhere including clothing, weapons, architecture. NO border, frame, watermark, extra heads, limbs or fingers. Fully opaque clothing, no nudity, sexualization, explicit gore. No generic aura, neon outline, glowing mist or energy ribbons.
